# Regression for cli audit #4: noCacheBust applied uniformly through runPipeline.
# Two generate runs with noCacheBust=true must produce identical output filenames.

sngl generate --lang=none --platform=html --out=gen1 --opt noCacheBust=true app.sngl
exists gen1/index.html

sngl generate --lang=none --platform=html --out=gen2 --opt noCacheBust=true app.sngl
exists gen2/index.html

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"

component main node {
    text(value="x")
}

window {
    main
}
